timing: Written before this round outcome calculations; prior Phase1E/F findings and user-supplied exploratory counts/medians were already known. This is NOT prospective independent preregistration.
data: Frozen Phase1F 90-direction concentrations/coefficients/flags, original source endpoint CSV and enriched trial evidence only. No retraining or new Web-ICE execution.

classification.framework: EPA OPP aquatic acute ecotoxicity qualitative five-class descriptors; species-endpoint screening comparison, not actual product or chemical-wide regulatory classification
classification.boundary_basis: Current EPA technical overview table: <0.1;0.1–1;>1–10;>10–100;>100 mg/L. Historical 1985 OCR and some subsequent summaries are typographically ambiguous at exact cutoffs; explicit current-table convention used.
classification.boundary_sensitivity: Same thresholds, assign all exact equalities to the higher-hazard adjacent class; never move thresholds. Use stored precision, no rounding or epsilon reclassification.
classification.category_shift: predicted_rank - observed_rank; positive = lower predicted toxicity category (underestimation of hazard); absolute shift = number of class boundaries crossed
classification.continuous_underestimation: predicted LC50 > observed LC50, distinct from category underestimation
classification.proximity: nearest absolute log10 distance to any official threshold; near flag within factor2 (diagnostic only, not EPA rule). Report observed and predicted distances separately.

endpoint_status: CI entirely within a single class
uncertainty.quality_status: Orthogonal specific-quality flag, not a fourth mutually exclusive CI status: known replicate mortality issue or measured-concentration deviations; original-report unavailability documented separately for all.
uncertainty.CI_interpretation: Closed reported experimental 95% LC50 CI. Compute all possible classes over [lower,upper]. This is a compatibility-set diagnostic, not a posterior probability or simultaneous 95% guarantee.
uncertainty.direction_status: For a point-class mismatch: target CI missing -> indeterminate_missing_CI; prediction class outside target-CI class set -> target_CI_incompatible; prediction class inside set -> indeterminate_CI_compatible. Point matches get separate compatibility labels.
uncertainty.robust_label: target-CI-incompatible means conditional on the reported target interval and a fixed predicted point; does not establish certain model error and does not propagate surrogate bioassay uncertainty or model uncertainty.
uncertainty.sources: Use available five isopyrazam assay CIs; do not invent inpyrfluxam or internal-compound CIs. HSE alternative inpyrfluxam point readings compared only for endpoint class stability; frozen predictions unchanged.
uncertainty.quality_sensitivity: Report omission of inpyrfluxam bluegill as target and as either target/surrogate separately; do not silently exclude all flagged concentration-deviation studies.

baseline.formula: target prediction = frozen observed surrogate input_ug_L (identity transfer)
baseline.pairing: Exactly identical compound/surrogate/target directions for Web-ICE and identity; no self predictions or post-hoc surrogate choice
baseline.deltas: Web-ICE minus identity absolute log10 error, FE, category mismatch indicator and underestimation indicators; negative error delta favors Web-ICE. Target-level MAE difference is principal accuracy comparison.
baseline.uncertainty: Apply the same target-CI compatibility evaluation to both fixed point predictions. Preserve surrogate CI availability as a limitation; no interval-overlap p-value or model-CI-as-assay-CI substitution.

summaries.primary_unit: Species–compound target endpoint (7 inpyrfluxam +5 isopyrazam), with n_surrogates, category-specific counts/rates, target MAE and paired differences
summaries.secondary_units: Surrogate–compound summaries and all-direction descriptive totals; compounds reported separately; internal six never pooled into external conclusions
summaries.macro: Equal-target average of target rates/MAE among covered targets; report target coverage and range of target performance. Direction-level median FE also reported for direct audit but not an independent sample statistic.
summaries.target_effect_count: Count targets where mean paired delta favors Web-ICE, identity or ties; no winner inferred from directions as independent replicates
summaries.inference: Descriptive only; no p-values, binomial confidence intervals, direction-level bootstrap or inferential claim from n=52. No pooled eight-compound external claim.

scenarios: TARGET_AWAY_FACTOR2 (observed target more than factor2 from all cutoffs; coverage displayed)
scope_limits: Only 3 exploratory figures and bounded statistical analysis

decision_rules.GO: Practically meaningful class discrepancies remain supported by available uncertainty information, accompanied by target-level pattern and defensible incremental model comparison; suitable to proceed to independent chemical validation, not proof of publication readiness.
decision_rules.CONDITIONAL_GO: Potentially informative classification/baseline differences, but limited by two compounds, missing or cross-boundary CIs, target dependence, or inconsistent transfer; independent compound evidence needed before a general safety-evaluation claim.
decision_rules.NO_GO: No informative uncertainty-supported category discrepancy or model-gain pattern beyond threshold/endpoint uncertainty/dependence; avoid adding data solely to seek positive findings.
